issue.title: Publication de-flap, truthful error digests, and TUI stall reduction
issue.description: agent_publication reports each (project, signature) cause once as a standing alert with a true attempt count and backoff. Its drain does bounded, reusable work with a cleanup that completes and leaves no scratch behind. Unrestorable prompt archives reach an audited terminal state instead of staying quarantined forever. The scheduler error ring and hourly digest group errors by signature, with durable true counts, a truthful coverage interval, and pruned digest files. Policy-initiated TUI garbage collections and sampled main-thread I/O no longer block the event loop for seconds, and tui_stalls.jsonl stays bounded, untorn, and usable as the acceptance metric.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202611/noise_publication_digests_tui_stalls.md requests this work

issue.title: Group the scheduler error ring by signature with durable interval counts
issue.description: error_groups: a sase-core normalizer turns error text into a stable signature. append_error keeps a durable per-interval counter keyed by (routine, job, signature) next to a signature-fair sample ring. Failed or corrupt writes are counted and logged once instead of dropped.

issue.title: Render one digest line per cause with true totals, coverage, and pruning
issue.description: digest_render: the hourly digest snapshots and resets the interval counter atomically. It renders one line per cause with count, first/last time, and a sample under a true-total and coverage header, with no loss after downtime or a crash. Digest files are pruned on a 30-day horizon.

issue.title: Turn repeated publication failures into standing alerts with backoff
issue.description: pub_standing: a sase-core decider keys publication failures by (project, signature) and reports only opened, changed, escalated, and cleared transitions. It backs off project-scoped failures. A standing store keeps true attempt counts and first/last-seen times, and one notification per alert fires only on transitions.
